meta.description: Independent civic projects for Berlin — Water for All, Wahl Kompass and Kommunal Kompass.

hero.blurb: We build multilingual, source-based information for Berlin — factual, neutral, and designed to make politics and administration easier to navigate.

items.name: Water for All
items.description: Water for All makes free drinking water in Berlin visible: the map brings together hundreds of public spots — fountains, Refill points and dispensers. In parallel, the project helps residents push for new drinking fountains.

items.name: Wahl Kompass – Berlin 2026
items.description: Wahl Kompass places positions from the official party programs side by side — with no endorsement and no party affiliation. Official texts appear only in German; we make them available in languages spoken in Berlin.

items.name: Kommunal Kompass
items.description: Kommunal Kompass aims to help Berliners reach local authorities on municipal issues. The project is still in research — guides and tools are taking shape.

about.title: Who we are
about.intro: We build practical tools that make political and administrative information in Berlin clearer and multilingual — independent and source-based.
about.body: Kompass Kollektive is the home of projects by Nina and Masha — Water for All, Wahl Kompass and Kommunal Kompass.

nina.name: Nina
nina.bio: Nina brings over ten years of experience in communication, content creation, and project coordination at international tech startups. Today she writes at Cee Cee Berlin about environmental and urban policy and advocates for political participation in Berlin.

masha.name: Masha
masha.bio: Masha brings many years of experience in project management and in building web and mobile tools for citizen science and environmental data. Today she designs the tech behind Kompass Kollektive and works for accessible digital participation in Berlin.

items.name: INA programme
items.bio: INA — Information. Nachdenken. Aktivierung. — is a Club Dialog e.V. programme for political education of Russian-speaking Berliners. It supports participants in developing and carrying out their own civic initiatives.

items.name: Kommunal Aktiv programme
items.bio: Kommunal Aktiv is a BVRE pilot programme for democratic participation of people with a migration background. It makes municipal structures easier to understand and accompanies engaged people nationwide as they turn local ideas into practice.

contact.title: Questions, press, partnerships, translations?
contact.blurb: Write to us — we reply in German, English, or Русский.

aiDisclosure.title: AI Disclosure
aiDisclosure.intro: This page explains how we use AI tools when creating content for this site — and how human editors stay responsible for what we publish.
aiDisclosure.howWeUseAiContent: We use AI tools to draft and improve website text — for example page copy and project descriptions. AI helps with wording and structure; it does not decide what we publish.
aiDisclosure.humanResponsibilityContent: All ideas, goals, and content decisions behind this site come from people in the Kompass Kollektive. Before anything is published, we check it for clarity and fit with our projects. Editorial responsibility lies with the Kompass Kollektive.
aiDisclosure.reviewAndAccuracyContent: We check content for accuracy, but errors can still happen and some nuance may be missed. If you spot a mistake, please let us know.
aiDisclosure.contactContent: Questions about how we use AI or about content on this site? Write to {email}.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you visit our website, in line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable German data protection law (including the TTDSG).
privacy.dataProcessedContent:
When you visit our website, our hosting provider may automatically process technical data required to deliver the site (for example IP address, browser/user-agent information, and request timestamps in server logs). We do not operate user accounts or require registration.

We do not use tracking or advertising analytics. If you contact us by email, we process your email address and the content of your message so we can reply.
privacy.hostingContent: This website is hosted by Vercel Inc. Server infrastructure and content delivery may involve processing outside the European Economic Area under appropriate safeguards (including Standard Contractual Clauses where applicable). See [Vercel’s Privacy Policy](https://vercel.com/legal/privacy-policy).
privacy.processorsContent:
We use the following service providers as processors (Art. 28 GDPR). Transfers to the United States may occur for some providers; we rely on appropriate safeguards such as Standard Contractual Clauses and the providers’ data processing terms.

• Vercel Inc. — hosting and delivery of the website.
privacy.purposeOfProcessingContent:
We process data to:

• Provide, secure, and maintain this website (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR)
• Reply to email requests you send us (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR and/or Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR, depending on the request)
privacy.retentionContent:
Server logs are retained by the hosting provider only as long as needed for security and operations, then deleted or anonymised according to the provider’s practices.

Email correspondence is kept only as long as necessary to handle your request, and for a short period thereafter if needed for follow-up or documentation, then deleted.
privacy.cookiesContent: Language is chosen via the URL. We do not set language cookies or advertising cookies. You can delete cookies and site data in your browser settings at any time.
privacy.yourRightsIntro: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
privacy.yourRightsList:
• Right of access (Art. 15 GDPR)
• Right to rectification (Art. 16 GDPR)
• Right to erasure (Art. 17 GDPR)
• Right to restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR)
• Right to data portability (Art. 20 GDPR)
• Right to object to processing based on legitimate interests (Art. 21 GDPR)
• Right to withdraw consent where processing is based on consent (Art. 7(3) GDPR)
• Right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR)
privacy.supervisoryAuthorityContent:
You may lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. For Berlin, this is typically:

Berliner Beauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit
Alt-Moabit 59–61, 10555 Berlin, Germany
[https://www.datenschutz-berlin.de](https://www.datenschutz-berlin.de)
privacy.contactInfo: To exercise your rights or ask questions about your data, contact us at {email}.
